title: Short clip from our interactive story game using AI-generated responses!
author: 404Stella

comments.author: 404Stella
comments.body:
Hey! We’re Anuttacon, a new independent team working on Whispers from the Star, and we’re currently looking for iOS beta testers to help us shape the experience.

This is our first game: it's an interactive story with AI chat, where the responds to everything you say in real time. If you’re into dialogue-driven storytelling, sci-fi, or just want to be part of something new, we’d love to have you in the test!

You can sign up here: https://wfts.anuttacon.com/.

replies.author: Airexe
replies.body: You guys need to hire a marketing team lol, there should be more people talking about this. Mind if I share this video around?

replies.author: 404Stella
replies.body: Feel free to share the video ❤️

replies.author: Worried-Cockroach-34
replies.body: Well I will be damned, pretty decent and tight. Love it

replies.author: 404Stella
replies.body: Thanks so much - we really hope you get to test out the game!

comments.author: Hungry_Ice4105
comments.body: The character responses feel surprisingly natural! What kind of model are you using for the dialogue generation? I've been experimenting with fine-tuning smaller models for narrative games and finding that context window size makes a huge difference in maintaining coherent character personalities throughout longer stories.

comments.author: MotionMimicry
comments.body:
This is so awesome, amazing work 🔥

Any you’d share a bit about your tech stack? LLM to audio2Face to UE5?

replies.author: 404Stella
replies.body: We’re not sharing tech stack details just yet, but what matters most to us is how natural and immersive the experience feels. If anything stood out (good or bad), we’d love to hear it!

comments.author: peterattia
comments.body:
Love that you’re experimenting and trying something new! I think there’s a bunch of cool ways AI could make NPCs more engaging.

I might be out of the norm, but this feels like it’s just a 3d portrait wrapper around a conversational AI? I do one shots with GPT on my drives to work. I just give it a scenario or ask it to make one up and… it’s exactly this, but without the imagery.

Not trying to knock it, it’s very cool. Just doesn’t feel very new to me in particular I guess.

comments.author: Ok_WaterStarBoy3
comments.body: I think you should add more expressive animations, linking them to mood

comments.author: Next-Pumpkin-654
comments.body:
"You sound really in distress"

Character: \*most calm, neutral expression I have ever seen in my life, voice sounds like it is barely feigning interest in the conversation\*

I like the idea, but some extra emphasis on presentation might help. Worried comments, asking you if you are still there and to hurry up when you don't respond for a brief time, looking around as explosions happen off screen, idk. Just feels flat, as is.

This also seems like comedy gold for someone who keeps going off topic or deliberately suggesting really terrible ideas. NOTE: I wrote that before I got to the end. Yeah, I'm guessing most players aren't going to be interested in saving the character, lol.

replies.author: 404Stella
replies.body: That's definitely a way to play the game 😂
